player_intent: Looking up and down bends the upper spine while preserving the source base pose and weapon contact.
acceptance_rule: Main source poses replace legacy local-axis pitch with a bounded world-aim-right upper-spine pass. Standing, crouched and prone have distinct saved gains and limits; unsafe actions suppress it; hips/feet and all authoritative owners remain unchanged.

nodes.role: Canonical driver coordinates the existing upper-body posture owner before weapon contact

visual_check: Inspect actual selected-character standing/crouched/prone up-neutral-down and fire transitions from side and rear; headless contact measurements alone do not prove visual quality.

system_delta.reason: Replace local-axis source torso pitch and fill source-pistol omission within the same posture owner; retain downstream contact and legacy fallback.
